ranked.headline: Benchmarks and error corrections reshape tools for genomic and metagenomic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark detection tools and correct amplicon-induced errors in sequencing and phylogenetic analyses.

ranked.headline: Learned models and spectral search drive MS/MS-based metabolite annotation
ranked.summary: Public spectral libraries and learned models now enable structure proposal and cross-polarity comparison of tandem mass spectra.

ranked.headline: Protein language models are learned surrogates for interaction, stability, and dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published study extend protein language models to stability, self-interaction, homology, and dynamics prediction.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models infer missing spatial omics layers from incomplete multi-omics data
ranked.summary: Incomplete spatial multi-omics and large spatial datasets motivate models that encode niche context directly into imputation and domain calling.

ranked.headline: Harmonized metadata layers and portable query interfaces for omics data
ranked.summary: Five 2026 preprints package harmonized metadata for public and institutional omics data into queryable, portable interfaces.

ranked.headline: ML and generative models guide RNA aptamer, sensor, and DNA synthesis design
ranked.summary: Computational models are increasingly used to select nucleic acid and nucleic acid-linked sequences before wet-lab testing across four recent studies.

ranked.headline: Computational tools infer cell lineage and regulatory function from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair single-cell and spatial data with new algorithms for lineage, perturbation, and regulatory inference.

ranked.headline: Single-cell methods map regulatory states across AML, tumors and chromatin references
ranked.summary: Single-cell datasets now support regulatory inference at scale, from differential expression and editing maps to chromatin reference building.

ranked.headline: Transposable elements shape genome evolution across fungi, flies, grasses and phages
ranked.summary: Recent studies apply pangenome, comparative and distance-based methods to resolve TE insertion history and horizontal transfer.

ranked.headline: Coarse representations reduce reliance on full atomic detail for binding prediction
ranked.summary: TerraBind reports 26x faster pose and affinity prediction from coarse pocket representations, alongside new scoring and design models.

ranked.headline: LLM interfaces make omics and gene-regulation analyses inspectable against literature
ranked.summary: Four February 2026 preprints pair LLM guidance or literature grounding with omics clustering, enrichment interpretation, and gene regulation extraction tools.

ranked.headline: Computational single-cell methods resolve liver and senescent cell heterogeneity
ranked.summary: Single-cell, spatial, and live-imaging datasets are now paired with deep learning, imputation, and explicit scoring of cell state.

ranked.headline: Computational workflows for DIA, label-free, cross-linking and PTM proteomics
ranked.summary: Recent tools address reproducibility and evidence recovery in mass spectrometry proteomics, from DIA quantification to cross-linking and PTM mapping.

ranked.headline: Sequence and structure models benchmarked on curated, split-aware biomolecular tasks
ranked.summary: Split-aware benchmarks and open models now test biomolecular prediction under matched training conditions and homology-based splits.

ranked.headline: Comparative modeling reveals conserved and divergent prokaryotic regulatory architecture
ranked.summary: Structure-aware comparative genomics now spans 16 gamma-proteobacteria and 202 cyanobacterial genomes, resolving regulatory features across lineages.

ranked.headline: LLM agents add structured reasoning to molecule design and ADMET optimization
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now test agentic and LLM systems across synthesis planning, literature mining, molecule design, and rare disease diagnosis.

ranked.headline: Single-cell multiomics maps regulatory networks and trans-eQTL effects by cell type
ranked.summary: Joint single-cell profiling of histone marks and transcriptome now yields atlases and models linking regulatory elements to cell-level gene expression.

ranked.headline: Deep models map DNA and RNA sequence to transcriptional and splicing-related readouts
ranked.summary: Sequence-conditioned transformers and flow models now predict perturbation responses, splicing, and RBP binding directly from DNA and RNA sequence.

ranked.headline: Allee effects and game-theoretic switching shape structured population dynamics
ranked.summary: Individual-based, analytical, and tumor-evolution models now link pulsed rainfall, payoff structure, and resource competition to population-level outcomes.

ranked.headline: Scalable algorithms for allele genotyping, primer design, and single-cell demultiplexing
ranked.summary: Highly polymorphic loci and pooled single-cell data demand genotyping tools that scale without losing accuracy.

ranked.headline: Mutational and structural probes of molecular recognition and frustration in proteins
ranked.summary: Residue-level perturbation and energetic analysis now resolve how single substitutions reshape TCR escape, condensate contacts and folding frustration.

ranked.headline: Language model representations and training dynamics predict human fMRI brain activity
ranked.summary: Scaling, compression, temporal context, and embedding trajectories are being tested as predictors of human language-network and cognitive activity.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models couple regulation, metabolism, and growth to emergent system dynamics
ranked.summary: Mechanistic models increasingly integrate molecular, process, and organismal scales to predict system behavior beyond single-level data.

ranked.headline: Structural priors regularize high-dimensional omics and drug-association estimators
ranked.summary: Ultra-high-dimensional, correlated biological features are pushing estimators to encode dependence and network structure directly in the model.

ranked.headline: Shared latent and physics-constrained priors for incomplete multimodal biomedical data
ranked.summary: Incomplete, batch-affected omics and histology data are pushing deep models to encode explicit structural priors directly into their architectures.

ranked.headline: Feature-based computational prediction of genomic elements from long-read data
ranked.summary: Long-read assemblies and pangenome resources are enabling de novo, feature-based prediction of fungal centromeres and plant accessible chromatin regions.

ranked.headline: Models infer state transitions and network structure from dynamical measurements
ranked.summary: Learned dynamical models now forecast single-cell trajectories and recover hidden connectivity and regulatory structure from measurements.

ranked.headline: Open simulation software for epidemic, trajectory, and regulatory data
ranked.summary: Recent releases package simulation and trajectory analysis as installable, open-source tools for reproducible modeling.

ranked.headline: Recombination, plastome inversions and TE bursts reshape genome structure across taxa
ranked.summary: Sequence-based structural resolution now distinguishes recombination, inversions and selection signatures across hybrid, plant, reptile and human genomes.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for cryo-EM particle selection and RNA motif structure modeling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication add an open RNA motif dataset and alignment and filtering methods for cryo-EM particle processing.

ranked.headline: Simulations link residue features to flux, membrane fusion and carrier steering
ranked.summary: Enhanced-sampling and coarse-grained simulations now resolve transport and fusion mechanisms at residue resolution across condensates and membranes.

ranked.headline: Generative models condition molecule generation on learned latent representations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published study pair transformer and equivariant diffusion models with latent-space or context-aware molecular generation.

ranked.headline: Heterogeneity in stress, temperature, and transmission reshapes epidemic dynamics
ranked.summary: Models now encode stress, temperature-driven infection loss, and superspreading as explicit components governing population-level epidemic behavior.

ranked.headline: Graph-based genomic representations scale to biobank and pangenome-level analyses
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale datasets and low-coverage sequencing now feed graph-based representations, motivating stable, fast infrastructure.

ranked.headline: Explicit generative models of evolution are tested against protein and pangenome data
ranked.summary: Explicit evolutionary models are now evaluated directly against large genomic and protein datasets, testing mechanistic assumptions.

ranked.headline: Resting-state fMRI and diffusion MRI link brain connectivity to behavior and symptoms
ranked.summary: Open diffusion MRI datasets and noise-robust connectivity methods are emerging alongside causal and deep learning models of fMRI-derived brain signals.

ranked.headline: Unified pipelines link RNA virus polymerase profiles, ICTV taxonomy and domain annotation
ranked.summary: Viral discovery and annotation tools now integrate public RdRp profile databases and ICTV taxonomy into single automated workflows.

ranked.headline: New tools map coevolving residues, dynamic communities, and cryo-ET particle features
ranked.summary: Coevolution, molecular dynamics, and cryo-electron tomography datasets are each yielding new computational descriptors of protein and particle structure.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale and pangenome assemblies advance fungal and polyploid crop genomics
ranked.summary: Recent chromosome-level and graph pangenome releases extend haplotype-aware genome representation to a fungal pathogen and a mixed-ploidy crop.

ranked.headline: Diffusion models for biomolecular design gain alignment and conformational control
ranked.summary: Recent preprints probe alignment dynamics, inference-time energy biasing, and sampling strategies in protein and biomolecular generative models.
